CustomField.description: Picklist that drives what this section renders: Field Set, Repeater, Table, Flow, Lightning Web Component, or Display Text. The formTemplatePageSection LWC reads this (via the derived isFieldSet/isRepeater/isTable/isFlow formula checkboxes and direct equality for LWC/Display Text) to pick its render branch. Field Set/Repeater/Table render a Form Component; Flow renders a Screen Flow; Lightning Web Component renders the component named in lwcComponentName; Display Text renders only rich text. Set in the page section configurator's Component tab.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick what this section displays: a Field Set, Repeater, or Table form component, an embedded Screen Flow, a custom Lightning Web Component, or static Display Text. Your choice controls which source field becomes visible (Form, Flow, or component name) and which Customize tabs appear.
CustomField.label: Component Type
